scope: Conditional discrete-horizon first-exit/resolution trajectories for observed current cohorts. No full event-log, new-arrival, or causal deployment claim.

borg.selection_metric: Development macro fraction CRPS averaged over three seeds

bpi.selection_metric: Development macro fraction CRPS averaged over three seeds

model_update_policy: Use frozen development-selected individual and coupling checkpoints. No final retraining, recalibration, architecture/threshold selection, or best-seed selection.
additional_baseline: Historical aggregate residual bootstrap, fitted on development origins. Standardized four-horizon errors, shared resampled origin, nearest log2 group-size bin, clipped/rounded/monotonized counts. Does not preserve individual CDFs or entity-level coherence; compare separately. Development evaluation leaves each origin out.

projections.relations: Known job/machine or handler groups with at least five current entities
projections.normalization: Each group score divided by its current size; equal group, horizon, projection and origin weights

metrics: fraction of groups with >=20% exits CRPS
current-cohort reserve loss with under/over ratios3 and9

inference.interpretation: Descriptive paired intervals; no IID task-count inference or unqualified cross-site generalization

sensitivity_plan: Report per-horizon and per-projection scores, not only macro averages
Check Monte Carlo stability with1024 draws for seed0
Report cutoff-wise marginal bias and calibration
Report known-imputation and unknown-initial-age marginal-score strata using cutoff features; no outcome-defined filtering
Report end-to-end scenario sampling and projection-scoring time and process memory; no isolated kernel-speed claim
bug_policy: If a correctness bug is discovered, preserve original artifacts, record exact correction and which conclusions may change, and rerun all affected comparisons. Do not silently tune after final outcomes.
